# Avalon Separation

> Manufacturer of sludge dewatering screw press machines, multi disc and volute dewatering systems for industrial and municipal wastewater treatment.

Avalon Separation designs and manufactures the Avalon Screw Dehydrator (ASD) series — multi disc screw press machines for continuous, low-energy sludge dewatering in STP, ETP, food, chemical, textile, and dairy plants. 11+ years of expertise, 288+ installations.
